name: Supabase Kotlin client (supabase-kt)
ask: Do you use Supabase Auth (auth-kt / compose-auth)? If yes, declare the identifiers you sign users in with: Personal info / Email address and/or Phone number, and Personal info / User IDs, for Account management and App functionality. Social sign-in may add Name.

What do you store in Postgres tables (postgrest-kt) and Realtime channels? Declare every data type you write there (e.g. Name, Address, Messages / Other in-app messages, App activity, Health info) with the purposes you use it for.
Do you upload files to Supabase Storage (storage-kt)? If yes, declare Photos and videos / Photos or Videos, Audio files, or Files and docs as applicable.
Do Edge Functions (functions-kt) forward data to third parties for their own use? If yes, mark those data types as shared.
Do you offer account/data deletion? Play requires an account-deletion path for apps that let users create accounts.

sources.title: supabase-kt README (modules, Maven coordinates, community status)
Supabase Privacy Notice (Customer Data processed as processor)

notes: No Play Data safety guide exists for Supabase or supabase-kt, and the supabase-kt README says nothing about library telemetry. Supabase's Privacy Notice says it processes Customer Data (e.g. data about end users of apps built on Supabase) primarily as a processor on the customer's instructions, so Supabase is a service provider and data stored there counts as collected by your app, not shared. Everything depends on what the developer sends, so all items are in 'ask'. supabase-kt is community-maintained ('working towards making supabase-kt official'). Module names: auth-kt (gotrue-kt before 3.0.0), postgrest-kt, storage-kt, realtime-kt, functions-kt, compose-auth, compose-auth-ui, apollo-graphql, coil/coil3/imageloader integrations, bom. Nothing is declared by default: Supabase stores only what the developer writes, so every data type comes from the ask questions. Reviewed 2026-11-13 against the cited pages.
